cards.text:
V-TD01/001EN
Alfred Early
Normal Unit｜ Royal Paladin｜ Grade 3｜ Power 13000｜ Shield -
[AUTO](VC):When placed, [COST][Counter-Blast 1], call up to one "Blaster Blade" from your hand or soul to (RC), and it gets [Power] +10000 until end of turn. If you called, draw a card.

V-TD01/002EN
Stardrive Dragon
Normal Unit｜ Royal Paladin｜ Grade 3｜ Power 13000｜ Shield -
[AUTO](RC):When it attacks a vanguard, if you have three or more rear-guards, this unit gets [Power] +5000 until end of that battle.

[AUTO](VC/RC):When placed, [COST][Counter-Blast 1 & Soul-Blast 1], choose one of your opponent's rear-guards in the front row, and retire it.
